actual_result.scope: Final hash readback after all three productions; actual old3000 native readback remains in regression evidence

actual_result.observed_difference: Both Mt=173, MZ=91.188 and MH=125. B04 MW=80.385 while B05 explicitly uses MW=80.419 from its frozen source-compatible overlay. Actual total/partial H widths and inclusive BR differ.

source_inspection.finding: Initialized mW enters the Higgs width prefactor and the charged-W contribution to the gamma-gamma loop; widths and inclusive BR therefore depend on model masses.

actual_result.causal_inference: The measured difference is consistent with the documented mass-dependent model and different W masses. A controlled reinitialization isolating the sole numerical cause was not performed.
actual_result.factor_policy: Use each actual initialized process BR once; do not coerce it to a PhaseF or external reference value.
